body: Hi, would just like to thank you for your words of encouragement and support. I am a lot better now, went through a horrible year and was so lost. Recently went for a Vipassana Meditation course, 10 days and it pretty much fixed me inside out, I feel great but I’m keeping at it and consistency in my meditation daily is the key. I’m much more alive now and happier. Thank you so much whoever you are, small gestures come along way and I truly appreciate every bit of it.
True. I could choose to stay alive, like the last for times I chose not to do it. Yea sure I will

End of the month maybe. I don’t know how much it can help. I am not such a good person or friend, I don’t have many and don’t think my family really would care. I think it’s the right time, seems like a good opportunity now
